abstract.text: Delegate protocol for CloudKit file system sharing and configuration callbacks.
Performs any one-time initial preparation (e.g., creating root directories).
The share, if using sharing. May be stale outside delegate callbacks.
Unlike
, never answers from the listing cache: the server
is asked in both directions. A cached “exists” can be stale in exactly the case
this method exists to catch — a cloud reset behind a change token the server
kept accepting — and answering the registration check from that cache would
defeat the check. The result heals the cache either way: a hit is noted, and a
miss removes any stale entry so later listings agree with the server.
